entities.summary: Hamilton Gardens is located on the eastern side of Hamilton / Kirikiriroa in Waikato, New Zealand. The 54‑hectare (130‑acre) site sits alongside the Waikato River and comprises a combination of a curated collection of Enclosed Gardens. and freely accessible Outer Gardens. It is the Waikato region's most popular visitor destination, attracting more than one million visitors each year from New Zealand and around the world.
